A. Regular safety inspections - While safety inspections are important, they themselves don't require blast shields.

B. When any material is heated to above 350 deg C - High temperatures can create explosion risks, so this might be correct.

C. When working under reduced pressure - Reduced pressure (vacuum) conditions can create implosion hazards, which is why blast shields are often used.

D. Whenever students are enthusiastic - This is clearly not a valid safety criterion.
